description: Operational Freqtrade translation check of the frozen V4 weekly TSMOM candidate.
limitations: The candidate and its 20% volatility budget were selected before this operational translation check.
Validation and holdout dates were previously inspected, so this is not pristine unseen evidence.
The Freqtrade translation sizes each asset independently and is intentionally more conservative than covariance-based portfolio sizing.
The 0.15% per-side fee override is a deterministic fee-and-slippage stress proxy, not an order-book replay.
Each fold closes at its boundary and starts again with the configured wallet.
A pass permits only a separate prospective dry-run challenger, never live funds.
No AI/model calls, shorting, leverage or parameter fitting are permitted.
